proposals.title: 1. Add explicit section-boundary assertions
2. Use table-driven assertions for expected and forbidden wording
proposals.body:
**File:** `tests/unit/flow/skill-prelude-auto.test.js`  
**Issue:** The new test repeats several `assert.match` / `assert.doesNotMatch` calls with hard-coded prose patterns, which will get noisier as wording requirements grow.  
**Suggestion:** Group patterns into `forbiddenPatterns` and `requiredPatterns` arrays and iterate over them. This keeps the test easier to extend while preserving the same coverage.
